next.reason: 1985: "must not refer directly or indirectly to any program that has been called and has not yet executed an EXIT PROGRAM statement"; 2023: "the EC-PROGRAM-CANCEL-ACTIVE exception condition is raised ... If checking ... is not enabled, the results ... are defined by the implementor". Same ban on canceling an active program or one containing it. A violation, undefined in 1985, now raises a checked exception (program not canceled) or is implementor-defined.
